findings.text: the placed-step test supplies expected=(owned,) itself and then asserts that the same value comes back, so the production wiring at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:4091 is guarded by no test: deleting the argument that passes the run's TMPDIR into step_node_directories leaves all three tests green.

the TMPDIR equality at line 149 compares the code's output against worker_scratch_dir(RUN_ID) resolved through the same helper the production branch uses, so both sides move together and it holds whichever branch ran; only the is_dir() line at :150 can fail on the branch-selection regression this test names.

worker_scratch_write_roots restates the handed-root membership rule already implemented inline at worker_scratch_seal_root:1384 and again inside worker_tmp_mount_source:1540, so one rule has three copies in this module and a later change to what counts as a run's own scratch directory fixes at most one.

placed_step_argv restates the srun-argv-names-a-job predicate owned at reckon/crew/process_signal.py:677 (_run_uses_step) and partly at reckon/nested_launch.py:119 (_names_a_job) instead of extending either owner, so which argvs count as a placed step is decided in three places.

item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is that a dispatched worker runs on a compute node while coordination stays on the fleet node; reckon/_backends.py:3058 stops the composing host creating the run's scratch and reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1097 hands a placed step a scratch path its own node makes, which is the fleet-side defect this goal was still failing on, though the debug-partition route the manifest names under outside_scope still has no creator.

justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1057 follows the module's docstring idiom but names a predicate as a noun where reckon/crew/process_signal.py:677 names one as a clause.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:3058 skips the run's scratch while the seal still re-binds it and reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1097 gives a placed step the path its wrapper creates, but the debug-partition route the manifest records under outside_scope still has no creator and no test.
justifications.reuse: reckon/_worker_fence.py:1475 adds worker_scratch_write_roots without extending worker_scratch_seal_root:1384 or worker_tmp_mount_source:1540, which carry the same membership rule inline.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --name-only dafd87495f..2b04fe6263 lies inside the declared write paths, and the commit is one change with one test.
